name: baker
description: Baker data files: diagnostics, hover, completion and go-to-definition from Baker itself

baker.server.path.description: The baker-lsp binary. Empty: the one bundled in the extension's server/ directory, else baker-lsp on the PATH.

baker.server.args.description: Arguments for baker-lsp, such as ["--reference", "build/reference.json"] for a project whose project file names no reference.

baker.console.port.description: The running game's console on 127.0.0.1, for live values in hover and "Write the live value here". 0: none.

baker.sim.tool.description: The game binary that runs a project's scenarios (`sim`), when its project file names none with (tool ...). Relative to the project's directory; ${project} is that directory's name, as in /path/to/build/bin/stacks_${project}.

baker.live.inlays.description: Show the running game's value beside each value a live edit in the game has changed, as an inlay hint.

commands.title: Baker: Try this value in the game
Baker: Show what a layer changes

scripts.compile: tsc -p . --noEmit && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --outfile=out/extension.js --external:vscode --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node18 && esbuild src/project.ts src/views.ts src/sim.ts --outdir=out --format=cjs --platform=node
scripts.test: node test/grammar.test.js && node test/project.test.js && node test/views.test.js && node test/sim.test.js
